mechanism: Lisdexamfetamine increases blood pressure and heart rate while spironolactone is used for potassium-sparing diuresis, creating opposing cardiovascular and electrolyte effects; amphetamines may increase potassium levels, compounding hyperkalemia risk with spironolactone.
action: Monitor blood pressure, heart rate, and serum potassium levels regularly; consider alternative ADHD medication if potassium levels are elevated or cardiac effects become problematic.
